definitions.explanation: the percentage of households or viewers watching a particular TV program

examples.japanese: {視聴率|しちょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a program with high ratings.

examples.japanese: {視聴率|しちょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低迷|ていめい}→低迷：09332_teimei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{視聴率|しちょうりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧20%⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{視聴|しちょう}→視聴：04467_shichou⟧ (watching and listening) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate, percentage) → viewing rate

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (average rating)
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (peak rating)
- ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (household rating)
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (individual rating)
- {視聴率|しちょうりつ}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (ratings survey)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{視聴者|しちょうしゃ}→視聴者：02570_shichousha⟧ (viewer)
- レーティング (rating - loanword)
- {聴取率|ちょうしゅりつ} (radio listener rating)

TV INDUSTRY:
In Japan, Video Research Ltd. provides the main rating data. A rating of 20% or higher is considered a major success. Prime time is typically 7pm-11pm. Low ratings can lead to early program cancellation (⟦{打|う}ち{切|き}り→打ち切り：08296_uchikiri⟧).
